name: The Not-Yet-Full
pitch: Everyone you eat counts as your cultivation in a fight, with no cap anywhere, until a Core cultivator with 3,000 reviews sits down opposite a god, and the world can only teach its food to run.

new.name: The Tasting Book
new.effect: A soul-bound register. Opens Eaten Power and Clean Kill. Closes pills and seclusion for life, through Spoiled Palate.

new.name: Eaten Power
new.effect: In a fight, your power term is your realm's power base plus what you have eaten. Realm, suppression and slots do not change.
new.second_home: any build that consumes a cultivator: a blood altar, a demonic inheritance

new.name: Clean Kill
new.effect: A knockout of a cultivator adds 0.10 x their realm's power base x (0.25 + 0.75 x the health share they had when the last instant began).

new.name: Varied Diet
new.effect: +3 points to hits per different main technique eaten, to +60.

new.name: Still Warm
new.effect: For 4 seasons after a knockout, you hold the victim's largest tag-keyed L2 modifier.
new.second_home: any mimic, any rival who fights the same person twice

new.name: First Taste
new.effect: +50 points to art hits while the target's linh lực is above 60 %.

new.name: Held at Table
new.effect: A single hit of yours for 20 % of the target's maximum health or more breaks an open escape channel. Cost, cooldown and stock stay spent.
new.second_home: any hunter, sect guard or bounty NPC

new.name: Between Courses
new.effect: After a knockout of a cultivator, restore 25 % of missing health and 50 % of missing linh lực.

new.name: Spoiled Palate
new.effect: Pills do nothing for you and seclusion adds no cultivation base. Only defeats fill the bar.

new.name: Years at Table
new.effect: A knockout adds 5 % of the victim's years left to your lifespan, up to 3 x the realm's.

new.name: Honey Glaze
new.effect: Qi, c_art 1.0, cost 0.05, 0.85 s. Curse for 3 pulses: Sweet Ward.

new.name: First Cut
new.effect: Body, c_art 2.95, cost 0.15, 4 s, with Rush Order.

new.name: Tucked Napkin
new.effect: Body, lock tag, c_art 1.0, cost 0.03, 2 s. Curse for 3 pulses: cost_raise +50 %.

new.name: Second Helping
new.effect: Body, c_art 2.2, cost 0.08, 2 s, guarded on enemy health below 50 %.

new.name: Bottomless Sutra
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Earth. Carries the five arts and First Taste, and seals High Table.

new.name: High Table
new.effect: Sealed, Earth, size 8, Damage and Health acupoints, notables Varied Diet, Between Courses and Years at Table, capability #9 outermost. Theme: defeat.

new.name: The Reckoning
new.effect: Cultivators defeated is a public number. At each threshold NPC loadouts change, and at 1,000 the Event Engine sends hunters in a run with Tribulation's carry-over rules.

questions: Eaten Power is the only uncapped multiplier in Combat. At a share of 0.10, the whole census eaten clean comes to 884,760, a little under one Deity. Is that the ceiling you would want?
Should the tally be public at once, or spread by witnesses?

A build that cannot pass the Nascent Soul heart-demon gate stays at Core for ever while growing past it. Is a realm-stuck god acceptable, given that Hóa Thần are meant to be a handful of aloof beings?
Top-end M 210 outweighs every tally short of the whole world. Is it right that one well-built nobody of your own realm is the world's true answer?
